The second commit changed the companion geometry and facial treatment into a cat head, but retained the comet-prefixed selector namespace, spark trail, bloom behavior, pointer-mode branching, and reduced-motion controls.

inferred: The durable design decision is not a full replacement of the comet interaction grammar; it is a concrete identity substitution inside that grammar.
The retained comet namespace records implementation lineage, while the visible cat form records the current presentation decision.
proposed: Represent this in the continuity graph as one interaction system with two temporal presentation states rather than two unrelated features.
Use the visible cat-head form as current unless a later immutable commit supersedes it, while preserving the comet origin as provenance.
